title: Inter wasted Esposito’s hat-trick: 4–4 at Atalanta
caption:
Inter wasted Esposito’s hat-trick. Francesco Pio Esposito scored three in Bergamo, but Inter drew 4–4 with Atalanta after leading by two goals three times — the tying goal a stoppage-time penalty, per Inter.it. Çalhanoğlu may miss the rest of 2026, per Tuttosport; the club says only that he went off injured. Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.
